text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that parking be prohibited from 8:00 a.m. to 10:00 a.m. and from 2:00 p.m. to 4:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the north side of Caribou Road, between a point 44 metres east of Bathurst Street and Glen Rush Boulevard. Currently parking is allowed for up to three hours at all times in this area. It is also recommended that the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the south side of Caribou Road, between a point 19 metres east of Bathurst Street and Glen Rush Boulevard, be amended to a stopping prohibition in effect at all times. The proposed changes will alleviate traffic congestion caused by a combination of the parking activity of customers of businesses on Bathurst Street and student drop-off and pick-up…
